host_tests.capture_normalization: Repository and host target paths normalized; trailing blank lines removed.

limitations: This supplies caller-owned samples and a local projection primitive; ERTS publication, refresh, adjustment, expiry handling and configure selection remain open.
The validity limit is nominal elapsed time since the sample, not upstream NTP age or a UTC accuracy bound. Later service correction and nonregression clamping may differ from the estimate.
All samples are plain non-owning scalars, not authorization or security time. The time service synchronized state does not authenticate NTP.
Clock-specific submission, mapping and cancellation faults were not newly injected. These queries reuse the existing complete native query owner and cleanup policy.
IRQ, signal and reentrant console contexts are not qualified.
Zero C tracked blocks and exact joins do not prove physical root retirement.
Both prior failed realtime worker captures and the earlier combined mutex campaign object-store extent incident remain separate and unresolved as recorded.
